focus: Phoenix metro, including a Cruise America depot in Mesa
intro: These Phoenix-area listings were checked on operator-owned pages on November 19, 2026. Phoenix is a winter RV gateway to the Grand Canyon, Sedona, and the Arizona State Fair, and it mixes national fleets (Cruise America in Mesa, plus Indie Campers, roadsurfer, Blacksford, and Native Campervans near Sky Harbor) with long-running local fleets on the west and north sides. Hours are copied only where an operator publishes them; several local sites do not, so those rows say Not published. One-way, pet, and delivery flags are set only when the operator’s own page says so. This is a starting sample, not a valley-wide inventory, and it does not cache live RV availability. Peer-to-peer platforms such as RVshare and Outdoorsy show live inventory for a specific weekend. If a price appears, it is labeled as listed on a date.

listings.name: Cruise America — Phoenix (Mesa)

hours.notes: These are the rental hours on the official Phoenix (Mesa) location page. The same page lists separate sales hours starting at 8:30 AM. The depot is in Mesa, east of Phoenix.

listings.offersNotes: The official Phoenix location FAQ says Cruise America offers one-way rentals (additional fees may apply; discounts on some routes) and pet-friendly RV rentals. Confirm the route and pet rules when you book.
listings.visitNotes: The page calls this the Phoenix RV Sales and Rental Center. The phone shown is the rentals line.

listings.name: Blacksford — Phoenix RV Rentals
listings.area: South Phoenix near Sky Harbor (Chipman Rd)

hours.notes: The operator’s Phoenix page lists hours as 8am–6pm daily.

listings.offersNotes: The Phoenix page says one-way rentals between Las Vegas, Bozeman, Phoenix, and Seattle are available on request, and that well-behaved dogs under 75 pounds are welcome with prior approval (cats and other animals are not allowed).
listings.visitNotes: The page offers free transport to and from Phoenix Sky Harbor; text or call when you land. It also lists a WhatsApp number, +1 406-300-5715.
listings.feeNotes: Pet fee as listed on 2026-11-19: $50/day (max $250 per rental), plus a $2,000 refundable security deposit; a $500 cleaning fee may apply for pet damage or excessive dirt or fur.

listings.name: Indie Campers — Phoenix

hours.notes: Taken from the opening hours (08:00–18:00, Monday–Sunday) published in the structured location data on the operator’s Phoenix page.

listings.offersNotes: The Phoenix page describes one-way rentals from Phoenix across its network and says one-way fees vary by route and season. Pets are not mentioned on the page.
listings.visitNotes: Campervan and RV rental station operated by Indie Campers.

listings.name: roadsurfer — Phoenix

hours.notes: The operator’s Phoenix page does not publish station hours. Pick-up and drop-off times are set in the booking.

listings.offersNotes: The Phoenix page says you can book a one-way rental by selecting a different return station during booking. Pets and delivery are not mentioned.
listings.visitNotes: From the airport, the page says to take the Metro Parkway (PKWY) Rail to the 24th St./Washington stop, a short walk from the station. It notes nearby long-term parking costs a fee.
